observable_definition.interpretation_model: BACK illumination through fused silica / Ti / Au toward CuO. Detected electrons leave the CuO surface. Average polarization can contain contributions from Au-derived and CuO-derived electrons. Do not label it a pure molecular spin-filter efficiency.

detection.spin_rotation_optics: Electrostatic 90 degree bend before acceleration converts the initially longitudinal component to transverse at the detector.
detection.reference_sample: Polycrystalline Au without an oxide layer

sherman_function.note: Methods state P=A/S but do not give a numeric S. Do not import 0.18 from the tetrapyrrole paper.

detection.calibration: Alternate sample and bare polycrystalline Au after a complete quarter-wave-plate rotation, as described in main PDF pp.4 and 9.
